    button to download a ready-to-go version of Opera ("CleanOpera").

    instantly hidden.

  - No Scrolling Needed:
    The webpage is cleaned up and rearranged so the main green Proceed / Access
    button is placed right at the top under the title, saving you from scrolling
    through random text or fake buttons.

  - Automatic Task Handler:
    When you click a task button (like visiting a website or opening a link),
    Purify pops it open in a tiny mini-window, closes it automatically after 5
    seconds, and shows a clean countdown timer on your screen while it finishes
    the task for you.

  - Automatic Fake Email Sign-In:
    If the site asks you to sign in with an email to continue, Purify creates a
    temporary fake email, solves the security check, grabs the verification
    code, and types it in for you automatically without you ever opening an
    inbox.

  - Auto-Mutes All Noise:
    If a webpage tries to play loud video ads or background music, Purify
    instantly mutes all sound so your browser stays completely silent.

  - Instant MediaFire Downloads:
    Once you finally reach the MediaFire download page, Purify clicks the
    download button for you immediately and closes the MediaFire tab as soon as
    your download starts.

  - Status Badge:
